text: Allaahu On No Mehira jawle ribaa ɗen: ittugol barki kin e majje ekn, O Ɗuɗɗina jawle sadaqa ɗen O Mawninira ɗe cowalle mbarjaari. Moƴƴere nden yoɓiree sappo yeru mayre haa cowalle teemeɗɗe jeeɗiɗi e ko ɓuri, O Barkina kadi jawle wiŋtooɓe ɓen. Alla Yiɗaa kala keereero saɗta-hooreejo, dagiŋtinoowo haram, ñiiɓa e geddi.
